name: Computer use
description: Lets any agent see and work this computer's apps and browser, with @computer in the composer. Runs Cua's driver (cua mcp): accessibility tree first, screenshots only when needed.

requires.says: Install Cua's CLI, then allow it to act on this computer once (cua do-host-consent) and choose this computer (cua do switch host).

mcp.instructions: Computer use (the Computer use plugin, `computer_*` tools): the person allowed you to operate their computer's apps and browser when they ask for it (@computer in their message). Be fast and frugal: read `computer_get_accessibility_tree` (scoped to the window) before any screenshot, act on elements from it with `computer_accessibility_act` rather than pixels, batch what you've already decided, and take a screenshot only to check a visual result or when the tree lacks what you need. Never enter passwords, payment or identity details; ask the person to. Confirm before anything irreversible (sending, buying, deleting).
